I put off playing this game for about a year 'til I sat down and started a playthrough. I am not a huge fan of the D&D world but after the first 3-4 hours of story building I became hooked. Took me about 100 hours to finish my first playthrough. That is 100 hours of pure content, no "kill 20 wolves then return to me" quests like in other RPGs either. Every quest led to a bigger payoff. So many branching paths too that make multiple playthroughs a huge factor as well. The only gamer that I could see not enjoying this are people who have that goopy goblin brain that just want to play BF6 or MW2 remake all day.
